terra.problem: The line treats Judah’s Timnah and Samson’s Timnah as the same city. The sources distinguish two places named Timnah and do not identify which one Judah visited.
In the first moment, Tamar sat at the entrance to Enaim, on the way to Timnah—not at Timnah itself. The passage also describes Judah’s journey to Timnah rather than an event after his arrival.
